title.value: AN ACT concerning Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions
title.provenance: AN ACT concerning Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions

date.provenance: SECTION 2. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That this Act shall take effect October 1, 2024.

pfas_definition.provenance: (2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES;

type.provenance: ON OR AFTER OCTOBER 1, 2024, A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN: (2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES;

who.provenance: (A) ON OR AFTER OCTOBER 1, 2024, A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS... (B) A MANUFACTURER THAT MANUFACTURES, SELLS, OFFERS FOR SALE, OR DISTRIBUTES FOR USE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS

action.provenance: (A) ON OR AFTER OCTOBER 1, 2024, A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS... (B) A MANUFACTURER THAT MANUFACTURES, SELLS, OFFERS FOR SALE, OR DISTRIBUTES FOR USE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS

products.provenance: (E) 'PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS' MEANS PRODUCTS, MATERIALS, OR SUBSTANCES USED OR INSTALLED ON THE GROUND SURFACE OF A PLAYGROUND IN THE STATE.
